tenant.description: Has the value "live" if the object exists in live mode, or "sand" if it exists in test mode.
tenant.title: TenantMode

referenceId.description: A unique string to reference the Payment. This can be a customer ID, a cart ID, or similar, and can be used to reconcile the Payment with your internal systems.

parentPaymentId.description: The ID of the parent Payment, if this Payment is a child payment (e.g., a wallet).

companyId.description: The ID of the Company this Payment is associated with.

customerId.description: The ID of the Customer of this Payment.

customerEmail.description: The email address of the customer associated with this Payment. Required when `customerId` is not provided.

customerFirstName.description: The first name of the customer associated with this Payment.

customerLastName.description: The last name of the customer associated with this Payment.

customerPhoneNumber.description: The phone number of the customer associated with this Payment.

customerPaymentMethodId.description: The ID of the Customer's PaymentMethod to attach to this Payment.

selectedPaymentGatewayId.description: Default PaymentGateway used for the first transaction.

checkoutUrl.description: The URL where the customer should be redirected to complete the payment. This URL is provided after creating a Payment and should be used to redirect the customer to the Voucherly checkout page.

closeCheckout.description: Information about when and whether the checkout was closed by the customer.

success.description: Indicates whether the checkout was closed successfully (true) or cancelled (false).

date.description: The UTC timestamp when the checkout was closed.

closeCheckout.title: Payments.PaymentCloseCheckout

callback.description: Information about the last callback sent to your callbackUrl endpoint.

success.description: Indicates whether the callback was sent successfully (true) or failed (false).

date.description: The UTC timestamp when the last callback was sent.

callback.title: Payments.PaymentLastCallback

totalAmount.description: The total amount of the payment before discounts, in cents. This is the sum of all line items.

discountAmount.description: The total amount of discounts applied to the payment, in cents. This is the sum of all discount amounts.

finalAmount.description: The final amount to be paid after applying all discounts, in cents. This is calculated as totalAmount - discountAmount.

paidAmount.description: The total amount that has been paid so far, in cents. This includes both regular payments and voucher payments.

paidVoucherAmount.description: The amount that has been paid using vouchers, in cents.

amount.description: The remaining amount to be paid, in cents. This is calculated as finalAmount - paidAmount.

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. It can contain up to 10 key-value items with a maximum length of 40 for the key and of 400 chars for the value.
metadata.title: Metadata

transactions.description: An array of Transaction objects representing all payment attempts and transactions associated with this Payment.

items.description: A Transaction represents a single payment attempt or operation within a Payment. A Payment can have multiple Transactions.

paymentGatewayId.description: The ID of the PaymentGateway used for this transaction.

paymentGateway.description: Essential information about the PaymentGateway used for this transaction.

name.description: The display name of the PaymentGateway (e.g., "Visa", "Mastercard", "Edenred").

paymentAction.description: The type of checkout action required by the payment gateway.

x-enum-descriptions.OTP: One-Time Password authentication is required. The customer needs to enter an OTP code.

x-enum-descriptions.REDIRECT: The customer must be redirected to an external URL to complete the payment.

x-enum-descriptions.DROPIN: An embedded payment form (drop-in) can be used within your application.

paymentAction.title: PaymentGateways.CheckoutAction

image.description: URL of the image to display for this PaymentGateway.

icon.description: URL of the icon to display for this PaymentGateway.

paymentGateway.title: PaymentGateways.PaymentGatewayEssential

externalId1.description: The primary external transaction ID from the payment gateway provider.

externalId2.description: An additional external transaction ID or reference from the payment gateway provider.

externalId3.description: A third external transaction ID or reference from the payment gateway provider.

isWallet.description: Indicates whether this transaction was paid using the customer's wallet balance.

error.description: Error information if the transaction failed.

externalError.description: Error information returned by an external payment gateway provider.

message.description: A human-readable error message from the payment gateway.

code.description: An error code from the payment gateway provider.

externalError.title: Payments.ExternalError

error.title: Payments.TransactionError

requestedAmount.description: The amount that was requested for this transaction, in cents.

amount.description: The actual amount processed in this transaction, in cents.

voucherAmount.description: The amount paid using vouchers in this transaction, in cents.

noOfVouchers.description: The number of vouchers used in this transaction.

confirmedAmount.description: The amount that has been confirmed (captured) from this transaction, in cents.

refundedAmount.description: The amount that has been refunded from this transaction, in cents.

currency.description: The currency code for this transaction (e.g., "EUR", "USD").

creditCard.description: Credit card information if this transaction was paid with a card.

expiration.description: The card's expiration date, typically in MM/YY format.

expirationMonth.description: Two-digit number representing the card’s expiration month.

expirationYear.description: Four-digit number representing the card’s expiration year.

product.description: The card product type (e.g., "Visa Classic", "Mastercard Gold").

creditCard.title: CreditCardInfo

directDebit.description: Direct debit (SEPA) information if this transaction was paid via direct debit.
directDebit.title: DirectDebitInfo

holderEmail.description: The email address of the payment method holder for this transaction.

holderName.description: The name of the payment method holder for this transaction.

status.description: The current status of this transaction.
status.title: Payments.TransactionStatus

request.description: Information about the payment request, including any redirect URL or action required.

action.description: The type of checkout action required to complete the payment.

x-enum-descriptions.OTP: One-Time Password authentication is required. The customer needs to enter an OTP code.

x-enum-descriptions.REDIRECT: The customer must be redirected to an external URL to complete the payment.

x-enum-descriptions.DROPIN: An embedded payment form (drop-in) can be used within your application.

action.title: PaymentGateways.CheckoutAction

externalTransactionId.description: The unique identifier of the transaction in the external payment gateway system.

url.description: The URL to redirect the customer to, if the action is REDIRECT. This URL is provided by the payment gateway.

request.title: PaymentGateways.Checkout.PaymentRequest

items.title: Payments.Transaction

discounts.description: An array of PaymentDiscount objects representing all discounts applied to this Payment.

discountName.description: The discount’s name, meant to be displayable to the customer.

discountDescription.description: The discount’s description. Use this field to optionally store a long form explanation of the product being sold for your own rendering purposes.

amount.description: A non-negative integer in cents representing how much to subtract from the total. Must be specified when both `type` and `value` are null.

type.description:
Defines how the discount is calculated:
- `DOLLAROFF`: A fixed amount in cents is subtracted from the total.
- `PERCENOFF`: A percentage of the total amount is subtracted.
- `FIXED`: The final price is set to a fixed amount, overriding the original total.
type.title: Payments.DiscountType

value.description: The value of the discount, contextual to the selected `type`. Must be specified when `type` is provided and `amount` is null.

index.description: Defines the application order of this discount relative to others.

lines.description: An array of PaymentLine objects representing the line items (products or services) included in this Payment.

items.description:
Response shape of a PaymentLine, returned within a Payment object.

Note: when creating a Payment, the request body uses a different, normalized shape that nests product fields under a `product` object. See `Payments.PaymentLine.Request` for the create-payment request line shape.

quantity.description: The quantity of the line item being purchased.

unitAmount.description: A non-negative integer in cents representing how much to charge for each individual unit.

unitDiscountAmount.description: A non-negative integer in cents representing the discount applied to each individual unit.

discountAmount.description: A non-negative integer in cents representing the total discount applied to the entire line.

finalAmount.description: A non-negative integer in cents representing the final amount charged for this line, after discounts.

productId.description: The ID of the Product that this PaymentLine refers to, when the line was created against an existing Voucherly Product.

productName.description: The product’s name, meant to be displayable to the customer.

productVariant.description: The product’s variant description, meant to be displayable to the customer.

productImage.description: The product’s image URL, meant to be displayable to the customer.

productExternalId1.description: Primary external reference for the product, used by Voucherly to reconcile the product across systems and to correctly compute reporting.

productExternalId2.description: Secondary external reference for the product, used by Voucherly to reconcile the product across systems and to correctly compute reporting.

isFood.description: Indicates whether this PaymentLine refers to a food item. This flag is used to determine eligibility for meal vouchers or similar benefits.

isGift.description: Indicates whether this PaymentLine is a gift item.

items.title: Payments.PaymentLine
